messages:
Alex T: Quick kickoff for AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listing for Redwood Inference. Need owners for publisher creds, assets, legal. Can we triage now?
Maria (Partnerships): I can take publisher portal provisioning and creds. Need IAM role list and cloud account contacts.
Sara - PM: I'll handle packaging: trial SKU, pricing tiers, quickstart, description.
Kevin - Legal: I'll own EULA/privacy addendum. Any model-specific clauses?
Maria (Partnerships): @Kevin any telemetry or data-retention language we should add for marketplaces?
Kevin - Legal: Add short telemetry opt-out paragraph + contact for data requests. I'll draft and post to MKP ticket by EOD.
Alex T: Assets needed: logo svg + 300x300 png, 1-line blurb, 250-word description, 2 screenshots. Where to upload?
Maria (Partnerships): Upload to s3://redwood-partner-assets/marketplace/redwood-inference/. Naming: redwood-inference_logo_300.png etc.
Sara - PM: Proposed trial: 14 days, 10k token credit. Single-seat to start. Thoughts?
Kevin - Legal: Looks fine. Make sure billing/metering doc attached for marketplace billing teams.
Marketplace Bot: Created ticket MKP-4821 assigned Maria,Sara,Kevin due 2024-05-03.
Maria (Partnerships): Cloud contacts: AWS priya@aws-partners, GCP jon.gcp@partners, Azure carlos@azuremarketplace. I'll request publisher roles today.
Sara - PM: Quickstart snippet draft: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-2-instruct","input":"hello"}'
Alex T: Need billing SKU mapping from finance for each marketplace. Maria can you loop finance into MKP-4821?
Maria (Partnerships): On it, looping in finance now.
Kevin - Legal: Draft will be in the ticket before EOD; will ping legal-ops.
Alex T: Target: publisher portal access + assets + legal by Fri so we can onboard next Tue. Any blockers?
Sara - PM: Need one console screenshot showing Dedicated Capacity UI from eng.
Maria (Partnerships): I'll collect screenshots and ask for a short demo clip.
Alex T: Thanks all, updating timeline in MKP-4821. :rocket:
